meta.title: Privacy Policy — AutoRoom
meta.description: How AutoRoom LLC collects, uses and protects your personal data.

blocks.text: AutoRoom LLC ("AutoRoom", "we", "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your information when you visit our website, submit a car import request, or use our car search tool and import calculator.
By using our website and services, you consent to the terms described in this Privacy Policy.
Personal and contractual data:

items: Name and details (phone number, passport/ID, car link or lot number, budget, comment)
Car preferences, budget and purchase history
Financing/loan application data (if you apply for car financing through our partner banks)

blocks.text: Technical and usage data:

items: IP address, browser type and device data
Pages viewed, visit duration and referral sources

blocks.text: We use the collected data for the following purposes:

items: Processing car orders and preparing the final cost calculation.
Assisting with car loan applications through our partner financial institutions in Armenia.
Improving the website user experience (UX) and providing updates about our services.

blocks.text: To carry out international car purchases, we may:

items: Review and verify vehicle history reports (for example CARFAX, technical inspection records).
Pass the necessary buyer or vehicle data to freight companies, transit insurers and licensed customs brokers.
Keep the transaction history to provide post-import support and continuity of service.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
Our website uses analytics tools (such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel):

items: To ensure the website and calculators run smoothly and correctly.
To analyze user behavior and improve the structure and content of the website.
To run targeted advertising and retargeting campaigns.

blocks.text: We share data only with trusted partners, for the proper delivery of our services:

items: International search and logistics. Foreign auctions, dealer networks, sea and land freight carriers in the USA, China, Korea, Japan and the UAE.
Customs and legal. Licensed customs brokers and government customs clearance systems in Armenia.
Banks and credit organizations. Partner banks, to handle the car financing process.
Digital infrastructure. Cloud hosting, CRM systems and marketing analytics tools.

blocks.text: Because AutoRoom searches for and imports cars from all over the world, your data (for example the buyer's name, contacts or the car's VIN code) may be transferred to and processed in foreign countries, including the USA, China, South Korea, Japan and the UAE.

We apply commercially reasonable technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss, misuse or alteration. However, no method of data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

We keep personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the car import order, maintain customer service history, meet the legislative and tax requirements of the Republic of Armenia, and resolve possible disputes. After contractual obligations have ended, you may request the deletion of your data.
Depending on applicable law, you have the following rights:

items: Request access to your personal data
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Request deletion or restriction of processing of your personal data
Withdraw your consent to receive marketing messages.

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, you can contact us using the details below.
For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, you can contact us:

Email: autoroom.aic@gmail.com
Head office: Armenia, Yerevan, Sayat-Nova Ave. 20/2
Regional branches: Armavir
